messages:
maya: Heads up — discovered a KMS wrap key mismatch for some Vault ciphertext in kv-prod. Some rewraps are failing with metadata mismatch and a small set of secrets became unreadable. No confirmed data exfil yet but we need an urgent cleanup + rotation plan. :rotating_light:

sam: Which path/teams are affected? can you paste the error log?

maya: Error from vault during unwrap: `error=\"unwrap failed: ciphertext key metadata mismatch\"` for path `secret/data/serviceX/credentials`. Looks like partner ingest is still encrypting with the old wrap key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/old-KEY-abc while our rewrap runner expects current-key-id (re-encrypt target). We rotated the primary key last week but partner didn't update.

leo: Flagging impact — if unreadable blobs forced fallback to cached creds, we should check any temporary creds minted. Any signs of usage anomalies?

maya: No anomalous outbound spikes in egress. Logs show unwrap failures starting ~2024-11-03 02:14 UTC, small window while partner retries. Root cause: partner write role allowed use of deprecated KMS key; RBAC oversight.

sue: Agreed priority list: 1) prevent further writes with old key 2) snapshot vault data 3) dry-run rewrap in staging 4) rewrap prod 5) rotate service principals and partner certs 6) post-checks and audits.

maya: Exact commands I used in staging for dry-run:

```bash
# list affected ciphertexts (via vault API)
curl -s -H \"X-Vault-Token: $TOKEN\" \
  https://vault.internal/v1/transit/keys/kv-prod/ciphertexts?filter=key_id:old-KEY-abc | jq .

# operator rewrap (dry-run)
vault operator rewrap -dry-run -path=transit/rewrap -from=old-KEY-abc -to=current-KEY-xyz
```

sam: I'll open an RBAC patch to deny kms:Encrypt using old key for the partner role. PR: https://git.internal/r/rb-ops/pulls/79 (WIP).

leo: Rewrap needs kms:ReEncrypt and vault operator privileges. We should use an ephemeral oncall identity with limited TTL. Can we run under an ephemeral service account and log every action?

maya: Yes. Plan: create `ephemeral-rewrap@infra` with 1h lease, grant kms:ReEncrypt on current-KEY-xyz and kms:Decrypt of old-KEY-abc, and record actions in CloudTrail + Vault audit. Also disable partner writes to the path during rewrap.

oncall-bot: Approval required to execute prod rewrap job. Requester: alex. Approve with `/oncall approve 2h` or escalate to oncall.

alex: I'll own execution. Steps I'll take: snapshot vault (s3://vault-backups/pre-rewrap-1742501111), run staging dry-run 12:30 PDT, then prod at 13:15 PDT. Will post runbook and tag sec-ops.

sue: Add a CloudTrail filter and Kibana alert for unwrap errors: `unwrap_error_rate > 0.5% over 15m`. I'll wire to sec-ops channel. Also extend CloudTrail retention for these events to 90d.

maya: Checklist for rotation and containment: - Freeze partner role writes (RBAC deny) - Snapshot vault and take snapshots of KMS key policies - Run dry-run and full rewrap via ephemeral account - Mark affected secrets with metadata `rewrapped_by:1742501111` - Rotate serviceX runtime tokens and partner signing cert - Revoke any short-lived fallback creds we observed - Merge RBAC PR to prevent future old-key usage - Postmortem and retention of logs for 90d

sam: I'll coordinate rotation of serviceX tokens. Expect per-service restart ~3-5m window for token reloads. Will prepare fallback plan.

leo: After rewrap we need smoke tests: auth checks for serviceX, end-to-end writes to kv-prod, and verify unwrap_error_rate is zero for 30m. We'll also run a wide scan to surface any other ciphertexts still pointing at old-KEY-abc.

alex: Dry-run completed in staging — no data loss, minor warnings about TTL. Snapshot completed. Starting prod rewrap now. ETA ~20m.

oncall-bot: Snapshot finished. Rewrap job started by alex. Job ID: rw-1742501111-01.

alex: Prod rewrap completed. 2 failed batches due to token TTLs; requeued and resolved. All affected blobs rewrapped to current-KEY-xyz. Post-actions: merged RBAC deny for partner-ingest role (PR 79), rotated partner certificate, and rotated serviceX runtime tokens.

maya: Great work. Follow-ups (owners): sue -> CloudTrail filter + dashboard (by EOD), sam -> rotate any remaining fallback creds and confirm revocations (2h), leo -> schedule weekly ciphertext-key-mismatch scan (1w), alex -> upload runbook + snapshot hashes to docs.

sue: Dashboard + alert created: https://kibana.internal/app/kibana#/dashboard/rewrap-1742501111 (share coming).

sam: Confirmed service tokens rotated, all services reported healthy. Closing immediate incident with partner.

leo: Propose preventive guardrails: - Add CI check that partner onboarding includes key rotation within 24h - Add IAM policy lint that flags `kms:Encrypt` for deprecated keys - Add an alert on vault when ciphertext metadata key_id != allowed list.

maya: Agreed. I'll draft a short postmortem and next steps doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
